messages:
nina: quick sync: we need a consistent contract for retries at the gateway, especially for streaming/fanout routes. putting notes here before I update the API guide.
rahul: +1. the main pain is side-effectful endpoints (webhook-style) + streaming responses where clients expect ordering and de-dup.
marco: proposal: require X-Idempotency-Key for any non-GET that can mutate state. gateway should only retry automatically when idempotency key is present. otherwise, fail fast with 429/501?
tasha: agreed but what about streaming endpoints that are append-only logs (we stream tokens/events back as they arrive)? if we retry we might double-emit. Key needed, but we also need server-side dedupe at the upstream.
rahul: we can't mandate all upstreams implement dedupe. gateway can do at-most-once best-effort by tracking emitted message sequence per idempotency key for the resume window. cheap in KV as {idempotency_key -> last_seq, ttl}.
nina: that gets us into resume territory. tradeoff: more KV use vs safer client semantics. How about two modes: `retry_mode=hedged` (fast retry to another backend, can cause duplicates) and `retry_mode=safe` (serialize and ensure dedupe via KV + idempotency key). default `hedged` for latency-critical paths.
marco: defaulting to hedged will surprise some teams. need to document clearly and provide an opt-in header: `X-Retry-Mode: safe|hedged|none` and platform feature flag to default to safe for enterprise routes.
tasha: what should gateway do for stream truncation during a retry? i.e., mid-stream error -> gateway attempts retry to new backend. If hedged, client may see duplicated tail. If safe, gateway should return a 202 with `X-Resume-Token` and require reconnect. That's heavy.
rahul: alternative: for safe mode, gate automatic retries and surface a `Retry-Recommended: true` trailer and 503, leaving explicit retry to client with idempotency key. avoids opaque resume tokens but pushes complexity to clients.
nina: hmm. pushing to client sucks for user experience. maybe hybrid: for short lived streams (<5s or <N messages) gateway does transparent hedged retry; for long lived streams gateway flips to safe-mode behavior (no automatic retry, give 503+reason) unless client provided `X-Accept-Transparent-Retries: true`.
marco: add a small table in the spec for the conditions. Also define signal headers for upstreams so gateway can know if a backend can dedupe: `X-Backend-Supports-Dedupe: true`.
tasha: about retry budget: we need per-route quotas for retries to avoid traffic amplification. metric: `gateway.retry_budget_exhausted` and `gateway.retries_per_request`. Ops wants alerts when retries amplify > 2x baseline traffic.
rahul: can we have hedging only on cold tail latencies? i.e., run 2nd request only if first hasn't responded within threshold. that's existing hedge pattern but needs to be stream-aware: hedging should apply to the initial response start, not mid-stream chunks.
nina: agreed. document will say: hedging triggers only pre-first-byte. mid-stream failures follow safe-mode semantics. keeps complexity bounded.
marco: one more: idempotency key lifetime. suggest TTL = max(route_timeout, 60s) + jitter. make it configurable per route. also require server to accept repeated POSTs with same key and return same resource id/status.
tasha: security: idempotency key must be opaque and have limited size; gateway should not log full keys. rotate keys if we see abuse. add `X-Idempotency-Key-Hash` for observability instead of logging raw.
ops-bot: rollout note: feature flag `gateway.retry_modes.v1` created; canary plan ready.
nina: final call: I'll draft the API guide section with the headers, conditions table, and example flows: hedged pre-first-byte, safe-mode -> no automatic retry mid-stream, client-driven retry with idempotency header. please review PR when I open it.
marco: LGTM, will add CAS note for KV dedupe writes.
rahul: I'll add metrics and alert recipes to the ops playbook.
tasha: will notify SDK teams to add `X-Idempotency-Key` helpers.
ops-bot: canary deployment scheduled: gateway v5.12 -> 1% at 01:00 UTC
file_desc: Slack thread: gateway retry/idempotency semantics + streaming hedging vs safe-mode
